narration: The grit gives way to three older exemptions: water carriers, burial carts, and apothecaries bearing sealed vials. The fresh board preserves only Circle officers. Beneath a tampered floorboard you find a merchant ledger listing glass-vial deliveries to the tollhouse after it was supposedly abandoned. No bell rings while you read. The lawful route forward is a narrow passage roofed in loose gravel; crossing quietly would keep whoever changed the sign from knowing you found their supply trail.

payload.what: The abandoned tollhouse continued receiving sealed glass-vial shipments after closure, under an erased apothecary exemption.
